svg.title: Blueprint 11: Zero-Blind-Spot 8-Layer OpenTelemetry & OpenObserve Pipeline
svg.desc: Modern Athenaeum observability topology for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing all 8 instrumented layers (L1–L8), OTel Collector gRPC :4317 and http/protobuf :4318 fan-in, direct Browser RUM /rum/ bypass, OpenObserve v0.91.5 Parquet SQL store, and make status verification bar.
svg.text: Unified OTLP Fan-In (gRPC :4317 / HTTP :4318) • Direct Browser RUM Bypass • Parquet ANSI SQL Store

g.text: Non-blocking fallback if collector stopped • Exports OTLP gRPC :4317
Scrubs Authorization headers before OTLP export • Traces, Metrics & Logs
Paired with LLMTelemetry DB table & scripts/llm_usage_report.py
Receivers: postgresql (cache hit, locks) • redis (Valkey 8 ops/mem)
• L1 Next.js SSR + L2 Flask API
Public token: set short retention window
Single store for traces, metrics & logs:
for SREs & automated AI agent diagnostics:
Probes: OpenObserve /healthz • Collector :8888 • OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL alignment • Export errors past OTEL_EXPORT_GRACE_SECONDS • valkey-cli ping • llm_usage_report.py
